title: Bose's counting of light quanta
summary: Bose derived Planck's radiation law with a new way of counting identical particles; Einstein translated and submitted his paper.
why: Laid the foundation of quantum statistics; the boson is named after him.

unsung.contribution: Founded Bose-Einstein statistics by a new method of counting indistinguishable particles.
unsung.recognition: Seven Nobel Prizes went to research on bosons and Bose-Einstein ideas; Bose himself never received one.
